feat(host)!: frame clock, App and Live tick at a caller-chosen rate (rich-effects-fxiy.b40) (#288)

* feat(host): frame clock — App and Live tick at a caller-chosen rate on an injected Clock (rich-effects-fxiy.b40)

frameRate is the one parser of a rate: positive, finite, fractional (0.5 is a
frame every two seconds). App takes a rate and a clock, hands each frame's t
to its view, and ticks only while animate() holds and it is running; Live
parses refreshPerSecond through the same parser and ticks on its clock. The
effects-feel demo drops its own timer for App's.
